case.summary: Customer C09988 reported an unauthorized $59.67 card-not-present transaction on card C09988-K1 on 2016-12-11. The device was flagged as new for this account, and the customer denies making the purchase. Similar past cases (CC-2103, CC-1734, CC-0973) involved confirmed fraudulent online purchases of similar amounts ($59.44–$59.84) from different cardholders. The model risk score (0.37) is unusually low for fraud cases, raising suspicion despite the lack of a clear pattern. No additional evidence was requested, and the card was blocked. The case remains uncertain with a 65% fraud probability.
